entities.summary: Abu al-Hassan Ali al-Mandri al-Gharnati, also known as Almandari, Almandali, Al-Mandri I and Sidi al-Mandri, was the re-founder of the city of Tetouan in Morocco. He was born in Granada c. 1440 and died in Tétouan on an unknown date in between 1515 and 1541.
